## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Docs or tooling only

## Testing

How did you verify this? (e.g. `make open`, specific hover/tab/shell flows)

## Checklist

- [ ] Builds locally (`make build` or `make open`)
- [ ] Scoped diff; no unrelated churn
- [ ] Updated docs if user-facing behavior changed
